## Current Work

::: {.project-list}
::: {.project-card}
### CDC Data Processing Exercise

An analysis of CDC influenza vaccination coverage that cleans and validates more than 235,000 observations, examines missing data, and compares end-of-season coverage across age groups, flu seasons, and states.

[Open project](cdcdata_exercise/cdcdata_exercise.Rmd){.project-link}
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Complex Data Type Analysis

A Quarto exercise using `Biostrings` to read immune-related protein FASTA sequences, calculate sequence lengths and amino acid composition, group residues by simple properties, and make exploratory plots.

[Open project](complex_data_type_analysis/complex_data_type_analysis.qmd){.project-link}
[View source file](https://github.com/yangyin-zeng/YangZeng-portfolio/blob/main/complex_data_type_analysis/complex_data_type_analysis.qmd){.project-link}
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Starter Analysis Exercise

A beginner R analysis using the `gapminder` data from `dslabs` to explore relationships between life expectancy, infant mortality, and population in African countries.

[Open project](starter-analysis-exercise/starter-analysis-exercise.qmd){.project-link}
[View source file](https://github.com/yangyin-zeng/starter-analysis-exercise/blob/master/starter_analysis_exercise.Rmd){.project-link}
:::
:::
